summary: Iteration 4 tested. Backend: 35/35 pytest cases PASS (11 RBAC, 2 Search, 22 Reports). Covers /api/rbac/roles list+get+404, /api/rbac/modules (7 modules w/ features), PUT role (non-locked OK, Super Admin 403), POST role (blank + from template), duplicate (copy suffix + is_locked=false), DELETE (403 locked / 200 unlocked with 404 after), /api/rbac/audit recent entries w/ role_name+action+actor+ts+summary, /api/search?q=Apex returns mixed results incl invoices (empty q → empty), /api/reports/{pl,sales,expenses,stock} × {day,week,month,all} = 16 cases all return metrics+rows, unknown kind 404, /api/reports/{kind}/summary returns 'summary' with • bullets + base fields for all 4 kinds (Claude), /api/reports/pl/export.csv returns text/csv with attachment filename and CSV body containing 'Report' and 'pl'. Frontend: /settings/access-control loads, 10 role buttons visible with pattern 'role-{level}-{name}', Super Admin selection shows 'locked' copy. Finance Admin (role-high-finance-admin) selects, all 5 tabs (modules/features/approvals/scope/security) switch via tab-{id}. Audit drawer opens (audit-drawer visible). Duplicate creates copy and selects it. New Role modal (create-role-form) submits and selects new role. Global Search palette opens via global-search-btn (cmd-palette visible). Reports page: AI summary returned 682-char string beginning with '• Your business reported ₹3.79 lakh revenue…'; CSV export downloaded 'sales_month.csv'. Settings tiles settings-rbac + settings-migration both visible and navigate. AlertCard source contains min-h-[68px] and Dashboard alerts grid uses items-start.

ui_bugs.component: AccessControl · mod-toggle-* (Modules tab) AND feat-section-* header (Features tab)
ui_bugs.issue: Invalid nested <button> inside <button> — React logs 'In HTML, <button> cannot be a descendant of <button>. This will cause a hydration error.' Outer <button> data-testid='mod-toggle-{id}' wraps inner <Toggle> which renders a <button>. Similarly feat-section expand <button> header wraps two <Btn> (Enable all / Read-only) which are <button> elements. These are real HTML errors producing hydration warnings and can cause odd click bubbling (clicking Enable all also triggers the outer header even though onClick stopPropagation is used).

When typing search query programmatically via Playwright locator.fill('Apex'), 0 search-result-* items render even though backend /api/search?q=Apex returns 8+ matches. cmdk's Command.Input may not pick up the value set via .fill() (input event not dispatched in a way that triggers onValueChange). Real users likely unaffected (normal keystrokes work), but this indicates the component may not handle programmatic value sync. Recommend verifying with pressSequentially/type and consider using controlled <input> with onChange fallback.

action_items: FIX (HIGH): AccessControl.jsx — do not nest <button> inside <button>. Either (a) change mod-toggle-{id} wrapper to a <div role='button' tabIndex=0> with keydown handler and keep <Toggle> as actual button, or (b) replace the inner <Toggle> with a non-interactive <span> visual toggle. Same for feat-section header (lines 287-298) — move 'Enable all' / 'Read-only' out of the <button> header into a sibling flex element.

VERIFY: Global Search — open palette, type 'Apex' as a real user and confirm results appear. If cmdk Command.Input has a known controlled-value issue, switch to a plain <input value={q} onChange={e=>setQ(e.target.value)} /> while still passing q to Command for filter state.

MINOR: When auto-expanding feat-section-{module} on first load, currently the `expandedMods` state seeds only {inventory:true, finance:true}. For Finance Admin role the Finance module is visible but its section was collapsed by default in the test run — user has to click to expand. Consider defaulting to expanded for every enabled module of the selected role.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now 1266 lines (up from 922 last iteration). Strongly recommend splitting into routers/ (rbac, reports, search, insights, migration) — single-file maintainability risk is accumulating.
RBAC modules endpoint returns {modules: [...]} while other RBAC GETs return bare arrays — inconsistent envelope shape. Low priority but will bite a future frontend consumer.
RBAC create_role when template_role_id is provided but not found silently falls back to minimal 'dashboard read-only' template — should 404 or 400 to make misuse visible.
RBAC save audit entry stores actor=user['name']; /api/rbac/audit returns this directly. No timezone-aware display or action enum (create|update|duplicate|delete) documented in response schema.

/api/reports/{kind}/summary swallows all Claude exceptions into a generic 3-bullet fallback — good for UX but masks integration failures. Log exception with level=error instead of bare except Exception.

/api/reports/{kind}/export.csv does not handle unknown kind explicitly — it calls report(kind, ...) which raises 404, but StreamingResponse is still created lazily so the error path works. Add explicit guard for clarity.
Reports.jsx exportCSV uses fetch with manually-attached Bearer token from localStorage instead of shared api.get/axios — should use the same api instance to keep header logic centralised.

AccessControl.jsx is 525 lines and includes the modal, both toggle components, four tab render blocks. Split CreateRoleModal, Toggle, Check into their own files and move tab-content blocks into small components for maintainability.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% — RBAC directory/selection/tabs/duplicate/audit/create all verified, Settings tiles verified, Reports AI summary + CSV export verified. Global Search palette opens but programmatic typing does not produce results (likely cmdk quirk, needs manual retest). Nested <button> console errors on Access Control page.

seed_data_creation: Pytest test_iteration4 creates/deletes TEST_* roles within each test and cleans up via DELETE. Net-new roles after run: 0 (all TEST roles are deleted). /api/seed is called at module start so the 10 seed roles are always fresh.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration-4 backend endpoints stable. Use BASE_URL from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (export $(grep -v ^# frontend/.env | xargs) before pytest). Claude summary calls take 3-8s — pytest timeout per summary call set to 60s. For UI: (1) nested <button> console errors confirmed on /settings/access-control — main agent must fix AccessControl.jsx mod-toggle-* and feat-section-* header layouts. (2) cmdk Command.Input does not sync to Playwright .fill() — use page.locator('[data-testid="cmd-input"]').press_sequentially('Apex', delay=50) or page.keyboard.type('Apex') after focus, then wait ~1.2s before asserting search-result-* elements. (3) Features tab defaults to expanded state only for inventory and finance; for the Finance Admin role finance may still render collapsed — expand via page.locator('[data-testid="feat-section-finance"] > button').click() before trying to toggle crud-finance.invoices-delete. (4) Reports page AI summary is rendered after ~3-8s; wait for data-testid='report-summary' text length > 10. Export CSV triggers a native download; use page.expect_download().
rca_of_the_issue: Nested <button> HTML error RCA: AccessControl.jsx line 263-273 renders <button data-testid='mod-toggle-{m.id}' ...> ...<Toggle on={enabled} /></button>, and the Toggle component at line 477-482 renders <button onClick={onClick} ...>. React hydrates both and the browser parser throws. Fix: either (a) make Toggle a <span role='switch'> visual element since the outer <button> already handles the click, or (b) change the outer container from <button> to a <div role='button' onClick=... onKeyDown=...>. Same pattern applies to lines 287-298 where feat-section header <button> nests <Btn> components.
